head: e4248e7d2810aaa481c1a8e85d65ec9bddf6a996
classification_reasons: Spec not tight: one flagged concern stays open by design (intent Constraints say tests/test_calc.py is unchanged; intent Proposed outcome changes the message tests/test_calc.py::test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole asserts). The design picks the Proposed outcome and leaves the choice to the owner or the panel.

Small blast radius: one string literal in sample_pkg/calc.py, one added test in tests/test_messages.py, one updated assertion in tests/test_calc.py. No risk-list item, schema, contract or guardrail file.
Existing tests already cover the changed path (test_percent_zero_whole_raises, test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole, test_percent), and acceptance is exact-string assertions.
attempted: Fix round scope: commits after the last reviewed HEAD (85ad366) are 28c2d2b (gate evidence) and e4248e7 (spend recorded). spec.md and plan.md in the diff match the working tree and the version reviewed at 85ad366. The owner's fix request (evidence/fix-requests.json) is an empty '@claude ' comment with no change request, so the design was re-judged in full from scratch.

Intent: the spec's first requirement is the intent's Proposed outcome verbatim. Exception type, the non-zero return value, the unchanged divide/add/mean and the new test in tests/test_messages.py are all carried over. Both open questions are answered with the intent's defaults and reasons taken from the code. The spec solves the stated problem, not a nearby one.

Spec and plan: every Proposed outcome and Constraint maps to a requirement. The one internal contradiction in the intent is raised as the single flagged concern, with the choice, the alternative and who decides. plan.md lists the three files with exact lines and strings, in an order consistent with the design.

Proof: phase (b) writes no code, so no toolchain logs are claimed. gate-b.json's runner-run commands show today's suite at 11 passed (9 test_calc, 1 test_flag, 1 test_messages), which matches the plan's 'today's 11, 12 after step 2'. The Proof section names the new test, the updated assertion and every existing test.

Blast radius: outside changes/, Grep finds 'whole must not be zero' only in sample_pkg/calc.py:18 and tests/test_calc.py:28, as plan.md Risks claims. No other caller. sample_pkg/__init__.py does not move. CLAUDE.md Layout ('raises the same on a zero whole') describes the exception type and stays correct; no public function is added. The diff stays inside the change folder: no guardrail file, no risk-list item.

Policies: coding-standards rule 4 is met by a new exact-message test that fails on today's code. The test_calc.py update is in a feature-type change (status.yaml change_type: feature, tests_locked: false), so REVIEW.md's fix-type test lock does not apply. It updates an assertion that pins behaviour the owner asked to change, is not a weakening, and is disclosed as the open concern. Security-baseline, data-conventions and ux-conventions do not apply (library, numeric argument echoed back to its own caller, no storage or logs).

Tests: the new test asserts the exact string for percent(5, 0), so rendering part*100 (500) or whole (0) would fail it. The updated test_calc.py assertion covers percent(1, 0). No test catches an accidental removal of 'from None'; the plan records this as a risk and as an option not taken. The retained test name '..._names_whole' is a nit the plan acknowledges.
Skip markers: not applicable at phase (b); the design skips, narrows or deletes no test.

Claims against today's code (working tree = merge base for these files): calc.py:10 f"cannot divide {a} by zero" (true); calc.py:16 divide(part * 100, whole) (true); calc.py:18 raise ZeroDivisionError("whole must not be zero") from None (true); test_calc.py:25-28 test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole calls percent(1, 0) and asserts the old message on line 28 (true); test_messages.py imports only divide, has one test test_divide_by_zero_names_dividend (true); test_percent asserts 25.0 and 7.0 (true); mean rejects empty before dividing (true); change 0016 spec settled str()/f-string rendering for divide (true, 0016 spec.md lines 6-7 and 69-73). docs/decisions/index.md is not cited and is not part of this project. No claim was contradicted.

Stale-statement check: plan.md Risks 'Run infrastructure' records that the earlier reviewer could not start on claude-opus-5-5 and predicts phase (c) will hit the same error. That is a historical note about the run, not a design claim; it does not affect the steps and is not a reason. It may need refreshing if the reviewer now starts on the pinned model.

Deferred review: the open concern's closing and the panel files are not expected in this diff, and their absence is not a reason. Runner records (claude-b.json, run-b.json, adversarial-review-b.model.json, gate-b.json) were not used for or against the design.
